img_545.description: Very heavy noise. A dark roughly triangular blob in the centre with thin lines spreading out below it, faint ring outlines around.
img_545.central_figure: an indistinct dark shape, possibly a figure in a long garment or a bird; not recognisable
img_545.sign_reason: no identifying features survive the noise

img_694.description: Very heavy noise. A dark elongated horizontal body low in the centre with small leg-like strokes, and two faint claw-like shapes above at either end.
img_694.central_figure: a long low creature with legs, perhaps a scorpion or crayfish/crab
img_694.sign_reason: elongated many-legged body with possible claws; could equally be Cancer

img_782.description: Heavy noise. A thick curved arc at the top, a V-shaped set of lines at the right, and a rounded outline below.
img_782.central_figure: unclear; the arc and V-lines might be a bow and arrow held by a figure
img_782.sign_reason: bow-like arc and arrow-like lines, very uncertain

img_784.description: Noisy. A four-legged animal standing sideways in the centre, head at the left with curled horns, body horizontal, legs below. A dark rectangular patch near the head (masked). Around the edge, small figures and star-like shapes of the outer ring.
img_784.central_figure: a horned four-legged animal, like a ram or goat
img_784.sign_reason: quadruped with curled horns and no fish tail; ram more likely than goat-fish

img_925.description: Very heavy noise. Inside a faint circle, two elongated horizontal shapes, one above the other, pointing in roughly opposite directions.
img_925.sign_reason: two stacked horizontal elongated bodies inside a circle

img_801.description: Heavy noise. Two upright shapes side by side: a left one with an arc on top and a right one tall and narrow with a hooked base.
img_801.sign_reason: two upright figure-like shapes side by side; very uncertain

img_740.description: Moderate noise. A dark four-legged animal in profile, head upper-left with upright ears or horns, long body, tail at right. A rectangular block below its body and a dark disc at the left edge (likely masked patches).
img_740.central_figure: a four-legged animal, possibly a bull or cow
img_740.sign_reason: heavy quadruped with horns/ears; not clearly a ram or lion

img_260.description: Moderate noise. A dark low animal body in the centre with a long tail curling up at the right and a raised head area; faint writing in the ring around it.
img_260.central_figure: a four-legged animal with a raised curling tail, like a lion or dog
img_260.sign_reason: quadruped with tail curled upward over the back, typical of a lion

img_631.description: Heavy noise. Around the edges, several striped tub or barrel shapes (containers with small figures). The centre has only faint strokes, possibly a small figure with raised arms.
img_631.central_figure: not recognisable; outer ring shows people in tubs

img_844.description: Almost pure noise; only very faint lines and a small dark spot at the right.

img_361.description: Heavy noise. A horizontal bar across the upper centre with a short vertical post in the middle, and two round shapes hanging lower at left and right.
img_361.central_figure: possibly a pair of scales (beam with two pans)
img_361.sign_reason: horizontal beam with central post and two pan-like circles

img_593.description: Heavy noise. Faint writing at the top, a few dark smudges at left; no clear central figure.

recognise_source: yes: the tubs/barrels with figures, ring layout and script style suggest the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408)
